Ultra-detailed paint texture, chrome mirrors reflecting light subtly, realistic rubber tire surfaces. Freeze-action moment captured like ultra high-speed photography, dramatic suspended gravity effect, cinematic realism, shallow depth of field, floating debris sharply visible.
